```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

data_path <- "C:/Users/aderosa/OneDrive - Metropolitan Area Planning Council/Digital Equity - Resident Engagement Release Forms/Survey data pulls for gift card tracking/Qualtrics pulls"

export_path <- "C:/Users/aderosa/OneDrive - Metropolitan Area Planning Council/Digital Equity - Resident Engagement Release Forms/Demographic analysis/Survey counts by race and building
```

Load newest survey exports
- need to update file paths and variable names
```{r message=FALSE}
pre_survey <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "Apartment+Wifi+Evaluation+Pre-Survey_September+28,+2026_11.21.csv"))

post_survey <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "Apartment+Wifi+Evaluation+Post-Survey_September+28,+2026_11.22.csv")) 
```

Clean survey data
```{r}
pre_survey_clean <- pre_survey |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  slice(3:n()) |> 
  select(-c(start_date, end_date, status, recipient_last_name, recipient_first_name, recipient_email, external_reference, location_latitude, location_longitude, distribution_channel))

post_survey_clean <- post_survey |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  slice(3:n()) |> 
  select(-c(start_date, end_date, status, recipient_last_name, recipient_first_name, recipient_email, external_reference, location_latitude, location_longitude, distribution_channel))

rm(pre_survey, post_survey)
```


```{r}
unique_pre <- pre_survey_clean |> 
  mutate(unit_build = paste0(q88, q77, q89, sep = "_")) |> 
  group_by(unit_build) |> 
  mutate(response_count = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct(unit_build, .keep_all = TRUE)

unique_post <- post_survey_clean |> 
  mutate(unit_build = paste0(q88, q77, q89, sep = "_")) |> 
  group_by(unit_build) |> 
  mutate(response_count = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct(unit_build, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

Building split
```{r}
building_count_pre <- unique_pre |> count(q77) |> 
  rename(pre_surveys = n)

building_count_post <- unique_post |> count(q77) |> 
  rename(post_surveys = n)

building_counts <- full_join(building_count_pre, building_count_post, by = 'q77')
gc(building_count_pre, building_count_post)
```

Building + race split
```{r}
race_count_pre <- unique_pre |> 
  count(q33) |> 
  rename(pre_surveys = n)

race_count_post <- unique_post |> 
  count(q33) |> 
  rename(post_surveys = n)

race_counts <- full_join(race_count_pre, race_count_post, by = 'q33')
rm(race_count_pre, race_count_post)
```

#Export
```{r}
setwd(export_path)
write.csv(building_counts, "building_counts.csv")
write.csv(race_counts, "race_counts.csv")
```
